paper_title: Measuring (a Sufficient) World Model in LLMs A Variance Decomposition   Framework
caption: : Meaningful Variability Share
model_annotation: The bar chart illustrates the distribution of Meaningful Variability Share (MVS) and 1-MVS across five categories: Health and Nutrition, Logistics, Personal Finance, and Travel and Transportation, for two models: 70B llama and 8B llama. The horizontal axis lists the model names, with each model having a corresponding pair of bars for MVS and 1-MVS. The vertical axis represents the share values, ranging from 0.0 to 1.0, with tick labels at intervals of 0.2. The MVS bars are colored green, while the 1-MVS bars are blue. For the 70B llama and 8B llama models in Health and Nutrition, the MVS bars have approximate values of 0.6 and 0.58, respectively. For Logistics, the MVS values are around 0.5 for both models. In Personal Finance, the 70B llama model has a significantly higher MVS of approximately 0.7, while the 8B llama model has an MVS of around 0.4. For Travel and Transportation, both models have similar MVS values of approximately 0.05. The bars are not sorted in any specific order, and no bars are visually emphasized.
